text: Experiment 62 found that ciphertext autokey at distance 21 makes the copper's width-21 repeats. On its own it cannot produce the known letters, so this asks whether a column shuffle before or after it can.
In a ciphertext autokey each letter is keyed by the carved letter a fixed distance before it, so the first 21 letters have an unknown key. Known letters that land there cannot be checked.
3,107 shuffles, distances 1 to 95, all 24 ways of using the table, both orders: 0 fits, best 9 of 24.
